notes: Official statements reviewed for release. Reviews expire after seven days for scheduled refresh purposes. Decision dates remain unchanged; countries without complete dated evidence stay outside the verified subset.

countries.source_name: Bank of Ghana November MPC press release
countries.source_note: The November 18 decision aligned the MPR from 14% to 11% as part of the monetary operations reforms. The release specifies no separate implementation date.

countries.source_name: Central Bank of Egypt October MPC decision
countries.source_note: October 29 raised the overnight deposit rate by 100 basis points. The official deposit and lending rate table gives November 1 as the effective date.

countries.source_name: National Bank of Ethiopia November MPC decision
countries.source_note: November review retained 16%; July 13 decision raised the NBR by one percentage point.

countries.source_name: Bank of Tanzania October MPC statement
countries.source_note: October 7 meeting maintained 6.25% for the quarter ending December. The statement was issued October 8; July 2 was the preceding increase.

countries.source_name: Bank of Mauritius November MPC decision
countries.source_note: November 11 meeting raised the Key Rate by 25 basis points to 5%.

countries.source_name: Bank of Botswana October MPC decision
countries.source_note: October 29 retained 5.5%; the April 30 increase from 3.5% remains the last change.

countries.source_name: Bank of Uganda November monetary policy statement
countries.source_note: November 9 meeting maintained 12% after the October 14 special meeting raised the CBR from 9.75%.

countries.source_name: National Bank of Rwanda November MPC press release
countries.source_note: MPC decided the 75 basis point increase on November 25; the Governor signed the release on November 26. No separate implementation date is specified.

countries.source_name: Bank of Zambia monetary policy rate
countries.source_note: Bank lists the 250 basis point reduction as effective September 30. The fourth-quarter announcement is scheduled for November 27.

countries.source_name: South African Reserve Bank November MPC statement
countries.source_note: November 19 held 7.25%. The September 23 statement gives September 25 as the effective date of the preceding 25 basis point increase.
